newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Winbond sees '97 profit at T$2.094 bln.
newsitem.headline: Winbond sees '97 profit at T$2.094 bln.

text.p: Taiwan semiconductor maker Winbond Electronics Corp said on Tuesday it has set a 1997 net profit target of T$2.094 billion on sales of T$12.2 billion.

It said the forecasts, approved in a board meeting on Monday, were made based on expectations the global electronics industry would remain in a slump for the first half of the year but would begin to recover in the second half.
Winbond, Taiwan's third largest chipmaker, has not reported its profit and sales totals for 1996.
Many chipmakers in Taiwan have had profits hit by recent plunges in global prices of dynamic random access memory chips.
